case_number: 2025 INSC 349; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SLP (CRL.) No.6185 OF 2023)
summary: Challenge to rejection of discharge under PMLA; allegations of money laundering based on scheduled offences under PCA, 1988 and IPC; argument of retrospective operation of PMLA raised; applicability of PMLA to continuing offence considered; prima facie material found sufficient by Special Judge; High Court upheld refusal to discharge; appeal pending on issue of jurisdiction and temporal applicability of scheduled offences; standard for discharge at Section 227 CrPC stage reiterated.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3, s.4, s.24
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.11, s.13(1)(B), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Leave granted; matter pending final disposal before the Supreme Court.
